policies.week: Device-local Monday 00:00 to next Monday 00:00; end exclusive; calendar arithmetic handles DST.
policies.fractions: Floor to whole meters; invalid, negative and unsafe numbers are ignored.
policies.ties: Bots precede self, then avatar order provides deterministic ranking.
policies.storage: Persist {weekKey,best}; merge current-week maximum on every snapshot/record; storage failures retain shared in-memory scores.

scope: Only the model file is type-checked; concurrent parent-owned UI files are intentionally excluded.
